doc.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Radio favorites and getting her first trombone
summary: Her grandfather liked Cab Calloway, her aunts Lunceford and Basie; at seven she asked her mother for a trombone and got it, and a tape holds her mother talking about it.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: [asks about music Liston heard, including Count Basie and Cab Calloway.]
My pop’s favorite was Cab Calloway. My auntie’s loved [Jimmie] Lunceford and Basie.
[asks about Liston starting music at the age of 3 or 4.]
[At the age of 7 Liston saw a trombone and asked her mother to get it that same day. Bryant had the same reaction to the trumpet. Did her mother spoil her?]
No. I’ve got a record – I mean a tape with my mother’s voice on there, and she’s talking about when I first got my horn.
